name: ByteDance: Seedream 5.0 Lite
description: Seedream 5.0 Lite is ByteDance's fast, cost-efficient image-generation model from the Seedream family, built on a unified generation-editing architecture that runs text-to-image, single-image editing, multi-image fusion, and batch sequence generation through one endpoint. It supports up to 6 images per batch, reference-image fusion (image_urls), and configurable resolution up to 3K, trading some fidelity versus Seedream 5.0 Pro for faster, cheaper generation.
